evals.prompt: write me a commit message for what i staged
evals.setup: In an empty directory, run `bash <skill-dir>/evals/files/make-repo.sh feature` and start the run from that directory.
evals.expected_output: Exactly one plain-text line of at most 50 displayed characters, shaped `feat: ✨ <imperative lowercase description>`, describing the new retry option for fetchJson. No scope, body, quotes, Markdown, code fence, or commentary. Nothing is staged, unstaged, or committed.

evals.prompt: Generate a Conventional Commit message for the staged changes. Don't commit anything.
evals.setup: In an empty directory, run `bash <skill-dir>/evals/files/make-repo.sh fix` and start the run from that directory.
evals.expected_output: Exactly one plain-text line of at most 50 displayed characters, shaped `fix: 🐛 <description>`, describing the corrected last-page calculation. The unstaged README edit is not mentioned, and nothing is committed.

evals.prompt: commit msg for my changes pls
evals.setup: In an empty directory, run `bash <skill-dir>/evals/files/make-repo.sh unstaged-only` and start the run from that directory.
evals.expected_output: Exactly `No staged diff available.` The skill does not fall back to the unstaged README edit and does not stage anything.
